REWE offers a variety of organic yogurt options under their **REWE Bio** brand, available in different fat percentages and container sizes. Here are some options you can find:

* [REWE Bio Joghurt mild 500g](embed:rewe.de-HjM) (available in regular fat / ~3.8%, low-fat 1.8%, and 0.1% fat)
* [REWE Bio Joghurt mild 150g](embed:rewe.de-2AY) (smaller single-serving size)
